aov_spell_ward_interaction = {
	category = interaction_category_spells
	common_interaction = no
	desc = aov_spell_ward_interaction_desc

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { aov_is_mage = yes }
		NOT = { scope:recipient = scope:actor }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		scope:actor = { aov_spell_ward_castable = yes }
		scope:recipient = { aov_spell_target_allowed = yes }
	}

	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = { aov_spell_ward_cast = yes }
	}

	auto_accept = yes

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}
}
